title: Uncertainty Chain Completion — End-to-End Statistical Variability
brief: Connect three isolated uncertainty pockets into one chain: Material(±σ)→Force(±σ)→Deflection(±σ)→Finish(±σ)→Strategy(CI)→ToolLife(Weibull)→Cost(±σ)→Output(confidence). Add Taguchi, Markov, digital twin calibration.

units.title: Wire UncertaintyPropagationPipelineEngine into SFO
units.description: Replace SFO inline MC with UncertaintyPropagationPipeline (full MC/FOSM/PCE chain). Currently test-only.

units.title: Connect Link 4: Surface Finish(±σ) → Strategy Selection(CI)
units.description: CrossCamRecommender accepts Ra_distribution. Uncertainty penalty for high-variance strategies. Confidence interval on ranking.

units.title: Connect Link 5: Strategy → Tool Life(Weibull)
units.description: Wire StochasticToolLifeEngine into CrossCamRecommender. Full Weibull per strategy. Score includes P(survive target life).

units.title: Connect Link 6: Tool Life(Weibull) → Cost(±σ)
units.description: QuoteEstimatorEngine accepts Weibull tool life. Cost CI95 instead of point estimate.

units.title: Connect Link 7: Cost(±σ) → Pipeline Output(confidence)
units.description: P2P outputs statistical confidence: P(all_params_within_spec) from propagated distributions. Replace heuristic deduction score.

units.title: Sobol sensitivity at pipeline output
units.description: Sobol indices showing which input contributes most to uncertainty. Actionable: 'Measure kc1.1 for this material lot.'

units.title: Taguchi robustness in strategy selection
units.description: DOETaguchEngine for top-3 strategies. L9 analysis varying noise factors. Select best S/N ratio.

units.title: Markov tool state integration
units.description: MarkovChainEngine for wear state transitions (fresh→worn→near-failure→failed). Predict tool change timing.

units.title: Digital twin calibration loop
units.description: ProcessDigitalTwinEngine consumes actual results via MTConnect/OPC-UA. Auto-calibrate kc1.1, Taylor C/n, stiffness.

units.title: Uncertainty chain tests
units.description: 40+ tests: end-to-end chain, Sobol indices, Taguchi, Markov, digital twin. CI95 narrows with calibration data.
